title: FAQ — CSOAI
description: What CSOAI measures, how the harnesses work, what living attestation means, and what we do not do.
headings: Is a CSOAI score a certification?
text: FAQ — CSOAI Home Master Sovereign GovBench Pricing Products Council FAQ Article 50 Frequently asked questions What does CSOAI actually do? We measure whether AI systems follow specific legal provisions — 417 statutory provisions crosswalked across the EU, UK and US — on published harnesses, and we sign every result so it can be verified independently. Is a CSOAI score a certification? No. It is a measurement on a published harness with a stated method and confidence interval. Accredited certification bodies can consume our signed records as audit evidence — we are the measurement layer, not the certifier. What is living attestation? A signed record that stays current. When a regulation or model changes, corpus-watch flags the affected evidence and re-measurement is triggered. A PDF in a drawer cannot do that. What is the globe? The measurement globe plots signed measurements where they happened — the same data as the reports, made navigable. Where is the data? Benchmarks, harnesses and raw results are public on Hugging Face , Kaggle , and archived at Zenodo . CSOAI Ltd · UK company 16939677 · Every published figure traces to a signed, verifiable record.

register.note: CSOAI measures and publishes evidence. It issues no conformity marks and holds no accreditation. Nothing here is certification or legal advice.
